Interface ChatOptions

All Superinterfaces:
ModelOptions
All Known Subinterfaces:
StructuredOutputChatOptions, ToolCallingChatOptions
All Known Implementing Classes:
AnthropicChatOptions, BedrockChatOptions, DeepSeekChatOptions, DefaultChatOptions, DefaultStructuredOutputChatOptions, DefaultToolCallingChatOptions, GoogleGenAiChatOptions, MistralAiChatOptions, OllamaChatOptions, OpenAiChatOptions
public interface ChatOptions extends ModelOptions
ModelOptions 表示可在不同聊天模型之间移植的通用选项。
